newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-JP MORGAN SAYS STARTS NEWS CORP AS A BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-JP MORGAN SAYS STARTS NEWS CORP AS A BUY.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities said Friday that analyst Matthew Harrigan started coverage of News Corp with a buy rating.
Estimates for fiscal 1997 earnings were put at $1.28 per share and 1998 earnings at $1.24 per share.

"A fair 9.0 times EBITDA multiple and at-cost valuations for News' gaggle of startup businesses dictates 1998 price targets of $22.65 for the voting ordinary ARDs and $20.98 for the non-voting preferred ADRs," Harrigan said in a research note.
